Design Your 3-Month House

Original artist-drawn house · white base with original linework

The house keeps the artist’s original shape, outlines, brickwork, windows, and details. No grayscale filter. No added glare. The base starts white, and subscribers only change the house colors.

Preview version: Customization works here. Saving a house to the public Beacon Commons town, linking subscribers to their accounts, and automatically updating OBS require a separate Twitch login and storage connection. Exporting the image or design here does not publish it on your stream.
